definitions.explanation: Describes something that seems to have no bottom or limit. Used both literally (a very deep place) and figuratively (an appetite, energy, or capacity that seems unlimited). Often carries a sense of awe or exasperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、いくら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: With a bottomless appetite, he can eat as much as you put in front of him.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{沼|ぬま}→沼：02160_numa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{底|そこ}なしだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われていて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: This swamp is said to be bottomless, so it's dangerous to go near it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧ (bottom) + なし (without). Functions as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective modifying nouns: {底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～. Can also be written {底無|そこな}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{沼|ぬま}→沼：02160_numa⟧: bottomless swamp
- {底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧: limitless stamina
- {底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧: insatiable appetite
- {底|そこ}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{楽天家|らくてんか}: incurable optimist

USAGE:
The expression {底|そこ}なし⟦{沼|ぬま}→沼：02160_numa⟧ is also used figuratively to mean something one gets deeply absorbed in and cannot escape from, similar to English 'rabbit hole.' For example, a hobby that becomes all-consuming: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{底|そこ}なし⟦{沼|ぬま}→沼：02160_numa⟧だ (This game is a bottomless pit).
